title: Chapter 788
paragraphs: Chapter 788
Episode 194. Unexpected Encounter (2)
The Fire God, Shinu.
He is the god that all mages, including Solderet, most desire.

And Kelliac Zipl was the mage who received the most love from Shinu among all the fire contractors throughout history. Kelliac was also the only person in the present age who had felt his substance directly and conversed with him.
That god was now appearing before Jin and his companions.
The incarnated Shinu looked like a giant human made of fire.
Whooo...

As Shinu let out a deep breath, the companions unknowingly swallowed their dry saliva. Suddenly, the heat and thirst that could only be felt in the desert at midday was pressing down on the group. Just by looking directly into Shinu's eyes, it felt like the whole body would be set ablaze.
Unlike the other companions, Jin did not avoid Shinu's gaze. He did feel the pressure, but for some reason, he wasn't scared at all.
[Jin Runcandel…]
"That's correct. I am Jin Runcandel, Shinu."
[I've been hearing about your exploits. Indeed, you're remarkably strong and audacious.]
"Is that all you have to say? Quite bland. Especially considering you've come to ask me for a favor."
From the start, Jin didn't seem to care about Shinu's feelings and spoke boldly. His companions were startled and looked at Jin.
If the leader is confident even when faced with a tough opponent, the group tends to regain their confidence.
Jin's provocative words were actually loosening the companions' tense hearts. One by one, they also began to face Shinu directly.
Shinu didn't respond for a while.
In the meantime, Jin had a closer look at Shinu and realized that he smelled the same as Pi.

"It seems you've been through a lot. You smell just like the young dragon, Pi. The smell of blood and ashes, the smell of war. I'm concerned that your territory, the Land of Fire, might have been attacked."
[Ha ha, that's surprising.]
"No matter how much you try to hide it with your divine majesty, it's useless. You look like a seriously injured patient in my eyes."
[Yes, you're right. I'm on my way back from dealing with the guys who just violated my territory.]
"Who invaded?"
[I'll tell you if you agree to help me.]
"I see. I'm curious as to why you're so desperate for help. Why did you send Pi? Especially since you had to play your true hand like this."
[I was hoping for a lucky break. If you had accepted Pi's negotiation, I wouldn't have had to risk revealing myself.]
"Tch, a god who makes a young dragon do such a thing in hope of luck. Now I see why Zipl is the way he is."
Shinu did not show any discomfort to Jin's continuous provocations. Rather, he repeatedly smiled as if Jin was interesting.
[To put it bluntly, I want you to stop what the Sun Priestess is trying to do and kill it.]

"Oh, you're straightforward. But that seems like something I would do anyway, without you asking. You're not here to ask me to do something I would do anyway, you're here to provide information about Sanna, right? Because if I were to confront Sanna without knowing anything, it wouldn't be efficient."
[Yes, we understand each other well.]
"We'll have to see if our conversation continues to go well. While it is my job to deal with Sanna, if dealing with him benefits not only me but also you, I'll need to think it over."
[There will be no deal that could harm you. I promise on the name of fire.]
Whoaaa-!
Suddenly, a huge seal of fire formed in the void. A seal formed by the real Fire God, different from what Kelliac or Veradin had shown before.

There was no specific content in that seal, but Jin and his companions felt an absolute trust. They believed that there was no lie in what Shinu was saying, just like when Rosa first confirmed the prophecy and felt faith.
Jin nodded his head.
"For humans to trust someone, especially an enemy, it takes an indescribable amount of effort. It's quite a convenience for gods."
[It's not a privilege every god has.]
"But I have a question. Pi approached Zipl saying Sanna would fix Kelliac. Were you really fooled by that and stabbed in the back?"
[It wasn't me or Kelliac who accepted Sanna, but Veradin. If I could have stepped in at the time, the priestess wouldn't be in her position now.]
"So, Sanna took advantage of the gap when you couldn't help but be absent and quickly struck into Zipl."
"You mean Veradin is being used by Sanna."
[You seem worried about your friend? But he probably doesn't consider you a friend anymore.]
"It's because you guys messed him up. It would be wise not to speak ill of Veradin, Shinu. If you do, I might just slice you right then and there."
At that, Shinu finally changed his expression.
[You cannot harm me. On the other hand, I can turn this place into ashes in an instant.]

"Hahaha, you think I would be scared of such words? It's true you must have that power since you have the seal, but surely you're not in a situation where you can make such a choice. So stop bluffing. I'm suddenly curious about a question I asked my father when I was young. Can a human fight and win against a god, it was something like that."
Surprisingly, Shinu shrugged his shoulders and stepped back.
[I shouldn't have made such unnecessary remarks. I apologize.]
The more they talked, the more Jin felt that Shinu's situation was even worse than he expected.
"There won't be a second time for pleasant bypasses. I hope you keep your position straight in this conversation."
"Warning a god! Jin Gongja is so cool... Eup, eup!"
Quicantel blocked Enya's mouth. Shinu briefly turned his head towards Enya, then met eyes with Jin.
[Veradin and Sanna are probably in a relationship where they use each other. Veradin probably hoped you would find the Tower of Stories and dig up information about Sanna.]

"If Veradin is using Sanna, then the main purpose would be to keep you guys in check. And he would want to make progress with the demon sword golem and the sacred grounds. And Sanna? What can Sanna gain through Veradin and his Zipl?"
At that, Shinu gave a somewhat unexpected answer.
[Jin Runecandle, do you know where the demon world is?]
"Demon world?"
[Yes, the land where the demons, as they're known, reside. It's known to humans that this land exists in another dimension. That's not entirely wrong.]
"What does Sanna have to do with the demon world?"
[It has a lot to do. In the deepest part of that demon world, there is a leftover altar of the Sun God. That altar is the most powerful means to resurrect the Sun God.]
Jin's eyes widened.
"Continue your story."
[Sanna is now looking for the demon world. He needs to find the entrance to the demon world to reach the Sun God's altar. That's why he needs the power of Zipl.]
"Where is the entrance to the demon world."
[I don't know that either. But one thing is certain.]
Shinu pointed downward with his index finger.

[Underground. Somewhere underground in this world, there is a door leading to the demon world. But even if it exists in the same star, it's an area that can never be reached by normal means, so it's no different from another dimension.]
"Orugal must know its location."

[Yes, but knowing the location doesn't mean that just anyone can open the door. Only a special being blessed by the demon god can open that door and bring the demon race outside. Zipul assumes that the person fulfilling this role in Kinsello is Vishukel Evliano.]
- Vishukel Evliano! I've always wondered why the leader of Kinsello held you in such high regard. Can I witness your ability today? I hope seeing your power will be worth this humiliation.
- The demon race... Don't tell me, did you open the door? So this was your ability, Vishukel Evliano!
Words that Octavia said when she saw Vishukel with Ainus during the Sota desert incident.
At that time, Jin didn't hear her words, but since that day, Zipul has been assuming that Vishukel is capable of opening the door to the demon world.
Unfortunately, Vishukel doesn't possess such an ability, and both Shino and Zipul didn't know that.
"Vishukel Evliano. Somehow, I think his younger sister, Marjiella, has a higher possibility."
[Whoever it may be, it's certain that Orugal possesses a being capable of opening the door to the demon world.]
"Hold on, doesn't that mean Orugal is currently closest to the Altar of the Sun God?"
At that, Shino chuckled.
[He doesn't currently know that the Altar of the Sun God is located under the demon world.]
That was because Shino had wiped away the history when Orugal remembered the altar with 'Flame of Extinction'. Shino did not tell Jin about this.

[So, you need to be careful with your words when you meet Orugal from now on. If he learns about the existence of the altar, the resurrection of the Sun God will accelerate... and that's not something either of us want.]
"There are a lot of parts I don't understand. The best way for the Sun God's followers to find the altar the fastest now would be to combine the powers of Sanna and Orugal."

[How can they combine powers when their resurrection processes and purposes for the Sun God are all different? The sects of the Sun God religion are more wary of each other's faiths being realized than anything else. They would rather combine forces with non-believers than cooperate with other sects. Depending on which sect succeeds in resurrecting the Sun God, the shape of this world will change. Of course, neither option is good for you and me.]
"There's a lot of bickering among madmen. Anyway, Sanna is trying to find the entrance to the demon world through Zipul... Are you planning to negotiate with Orugal using Zipul as a substitute?"

[Sanna is more likely to just use Zipul's power to find it. Jin Runcandel, suppose there's a forest. And in that forest, there's something you need to find and destroy. What do you think would be the fastest and easiest method?]
"Burning down the entire forest."
[Correct.]
Then, Shino added with stern eyes.
[Sanna will try to find the door to the demon world, even if it means destroying this entire world.]
